Bundled browser libraries for offline-friendly warehouse scanning:

- `html5-qrcode.min.js` — html5-qrcode 2.3.8, Apache-2.0; source: https://github.com/mebjas/html5-qrcode . License: `html5-qrcode.LICENSE`.
- `qrcode-generator.js` — qrcode-generator 1.4.4, MIT; source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator . Copyright and license notice are retained in the file header.
